rules: ExecutionGate is the only execution authority for demo/live-like trade actions.
No execution from conversational or NLU paths.
Block entries when hard safety controls are active (kill switch, forced flat, reconciliation required).
Block entries during high-impact news windows when configured.
Block entries in unacceptable spread/liquidity conditions.
Prefer no-trade when confluence is weak, mixed, or contradictory.
safe_defaults: Paper mode unless explicitly switched to live outside Ask Atlas
No hidden command execution from normal conversation

evolved_strategy_promotion.shadow_drawdown_policy_note: Gross-normalized drawdown may be selected explicitly for demo-review gating when raw peak drawdown is judged metric-sensitive, but it must remain visible in settings, diagnostics, and review records.
evolved_strategy_promotion.live_boundary: Demo review eligibility does not authorize live promotion. Live promotion still requires demo evidence, human approval, and ExecutionGate protection.

voice_safety: Start/close system only on explicit command phrases
